triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_role_delete_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF OLD.is_system OR private.role_in_use(OLD.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Role còn nguồn sử dụng; hãy chuyển đổi trước khi xóa.' USING ERRCODE='23503'; END IF; RETURN OLD; END $function$

triggers.name: app_roles_resign_links
triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.base_role_links_resign()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT p.id INTO v_actor FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid();
  IF v_actor IS NULL THEN
    SELECT ur.user_id INTO v_actor FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.role_id = 'role-super-admin' ORDER BY ur.user_id LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE public.base_title_role_links l
    SET enabled_permissions = ARRAY(
          SELECT p FROM unnest(coalesce(l.enabled_permissions,'{}'::text[])) p
          WHERE p = ANY (NEW.permissions) AND private.org_role_permission_ready(p)),
        permission_signature = md5(coalesce(NEW.permissions,'{}'::text[])::text),
        revision = l.revision + 1,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE l.role_id = NEW.id
      AND (l.permission_signature IS DISTINCT FROM md5(coalesce(NEW.permissions,'{}'::text[])::text)
           OR l.enabled_permissions <> ARRAY(
                SELECT p FROM unnest(coalesce(l.enabled_permissions,'{}'::text[])) p
                WHERE p = ANY (NEW.permissions) AND private.org_role_permission_ready(p)))
    RETURNING l.title_source, l.title_id
  )
  INSERT INTO public.base_title_role_events (actor_id, title_source, title_id, reason, before_data, after_data)
  SELECT v_actor, u.title_source, u.title_id,
         'Tự đồng bộ chữ ký liên kết sau khi Role thay đổi quyền',
         jsonb_build_object('role_id', OLD.id, 'permissions', OLD.permissions),
         jsonb_build_object('role_id', NEW.id, 'permissions', NEW.permissions)
  FROM upd u
  WHERE v_actor IS NOT NULL;

  UPDATE public.org_assignments a
  SET data = jsonb_set(a.data, '{specialty_signatures}',
             coalesce(a.data->'specialty_signatures','{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(s.id, md5(coalesce(NEW.permissions,'{}'::text[])::text))),
      revision = a.revision + 1
  FROM public.mkt_specialties s
  WHERE s.role_id = NEW.id
    AND a.data->'specialty_ids' ? s.id
    AND (a.data->'specialty_signatures'->>s.id) IS DISTINCT FROM md5(coalesce(NEW.permissions,'{}'::text[])::text);

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

triggers.name: role_catalog_record
triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_catalog_record()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO private.role_catalog_audit(actor_id,action,role_id,before_data,after_data,reason)
 VALUES(auth.uid(),TG_OP,CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD.id ELSE NEW.id END,CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,coalesce(nullif(current_setting('app.role_reason',true),''),'Thay đổi qua cổng Role hiện hành'));
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW;
 END $function$

triggers.name: role_catalog_system_guard
triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_catalog_system_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF OLD.id='role-super-admin' AND (NEW.permissions IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.permissions OR NEW.name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.name OR NOT NEW.is_system OR NEW.catalog_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.catalog_state OR NEW.role_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role_kind) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Role Super Admin không được thay đổi qua cổng thông thường.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NEW.role_kind='marketing_task' AND OLD.role_kind IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.role_kind AND private.role_in_use(OLD.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không đổi loại Role đang có nguồn sử dụng.'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.name: role_new_empty_guard
triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_new_empty_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF NOT NEW.is_system THEN PERFORM private.role_editor_validate(NEW.role_kind,NEW.permissions,'{}'); END IF; IF NEW.role_code IS NULL THEN NEW.role_code:=NEW.id; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_source_rows(c jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, role_id text, source_kind text, source_id text, unit_id text, legacy boolean, eligible boolean, scope text, permissions text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT * FROM private.slot_previous_source_rows(c)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT (m->>'user_id')::uuid,r.id,'task',m->>'id'||':'||s.id,m->>'unit_id',true,private.org_marketing_eligible((m->>'user_id')::uuid,c),'native',ARRAY(SELECT p FROM unnest(r.permissions) p WHERE private.org_role_permission_ready(p))
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'memberships','[]')) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(m->'specialty_ids','[]')) sid JOIN mkt_specialties s ON s.id=sid AND s.active JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=s.role_id
 WHERE private.is_active((m->>'user_id')::uuid) AND private.base_valid_at(m) AND m->>'status'='active' AND m->'specialty_signatures'->>s.id=md5(coalesce(r.permissions,'{}')::text) $function$
